## Job Description

**Work From Home \| 7 LPA (6 LPA Base + 1 LPA Annual Bonus)**

**(Technical / AI Experience Mandatory)**

Qubrid AI is building next-gen infrastructure for AI workloads, GPU inferencing, and ready-to-deploy AI solutions. We help startups, enterprises, and developers accelerate AI adoption at scale.

We are looking for an **AI Techincal Marketing Associate** with **1–2 years of experience in technical marketing, AI product engagement, sales, or business development**. You must have **hands-on exposure to AI/ML, Cloud, or SaaS products** and be comfortable explaining technical concepts to customers.

**What You'll Do**

- Drive marketing initiatives across **social media, content, outbound messaging, and developer engagement**.
- Interact with new users and leads through **calls, emails, chat**, and nurture them through the funnel.
- Clearly explain Qubrid AI's platform, GPU infrastructure, and AI offerings in simple, customer-friendly language.
- Convert free signups into paid customers.
- Conduct **product walkthroughs and demos** confidently.
- Do **cold outreach** to build pipeline and qualify potential customers.
- Maintain and update CRM (HubSpot/Zoho).
- Work closely with marketing & engineering teams to refine messaging and improve customer experience.

**What We're Looking For**

- **B.Tech/B.E. or technical degree is mandatory.**
- **1–2 years of hands-on experience in technical marketing, AI/ML, cloud, or SaaS product engagement.**
- Strong understanding of **AI concepts, GPU usage, cloud tools, or technical product workflows**.
- Excellent English - both spoken and written.
- Confident on calls and video meetings; able to run demos end-to-end.
- Strong customer-handling and communication skills.

**Good to Have**

- Familiarity with CRMs like HubSpot, Zoho.
- Experience in developer-focused marketing or community engagement.

**What You'll Get**

- Competitive compensation + performance bonus.
- Rapid growth into **BD / Sales / Product Specialist** tracks.
- Direct exposure to global (US & enterprise) customers.
- Mentorship from founders and leadership.
- Work with one of the fastest-growing AI infra companies.

**If you understand AI products, love talking to customers, and want to grow fast in AI business development apply now!**
